department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
description: Central sector scheme providing direct financial assistance to all landholding farmer families across India to supplement agricultural input and household needs.
purpose: To provide financial support to landholding farmers for procuring crop inputs, seeds, fertilizers, and meeting domestic requirements.
location_scope: All India (including all 31 districts of Karnataka)
benefit_summary: ₹6,000 per year transferred directly via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.
eligibility_summary: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land, subject to statutory exclusion criteria (e.g., institutional landholders, constitutional post holders, serving/retired government employees, income tax payees in last assessment year, doctors/engineers/lawyers). Requires mandatory eKYC and Aadhaar-seeded land record registration.
application_method: Self-registration on the PM-KISAN online portal (pmkisan.gov.in), through Common Service Centres (CSC), or via Karnataka Village Agriculture Officers / Raitha Samparka Kendras (RSK) integrated through the state FRUITS portal.
documents_required: Land Ownership Document (RTC / Pahani / FRUITS ID)
deadline_or_season: Continuous enrollment; biometric/OTP eKYC and land verification mandatory before each installment release.
source_authority: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
validity_notes: Verified active. In Karnataka, farmer data is synchronized with the state FRUITS database for automated land validation.

name_en: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) - Karnataka
name_kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಫಸಲ್ ಬಿಮಾ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಬೆಳೆ ವಿಮೆ) - ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka & Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
description: Comprehensive yield-based and weather-index crop insurance scheme protecting Karnataka farmers against financial losses from non-preventable natural risks, drought, excess rainfall, pests, and diseases.
purpose: To stabilize farmer income during natural disasters and crop failures across notified crops and insurance units.
eligible_farmer_types: Tenant farmers / sharecroppers with valid cultivation records
location_scope: All notified taluks and gram panchayats in Karnataka
benefit_summary: Financial compensation for prevented sowing, mid-season localized adversity, post-harvest losses, and widespread yield deficits. Farmer premium is capped at 2.0% of sum insured for Kharif food/oilseeds, 1.5% for Rabi food/oilseeds, and 5.0% for annual commercial/horticultural crops; remainder is heavily subsidized by Central and Karnataka State Governments.
eligibility_summary: Farmers cultivating notified crops in officially notified gram panchayats/taluks during the respective Kharif or Rabi season with valid land ownership/cultivation proof. Enrollment is voluntary for all farmers.
application_method: Apply online through the Karnataka Samrakshane portal (samrakshane.karnataka.gov.in), Common Service Centres (CSC), Grama One / Karnataka One centres, Raitha Samparka Kendras (RSK), or designated commercial/cooperative bank branches.
official_contact: Kisan Call Centre: 1800-180-1551 / Samrakshane State Helpdesk
documents_required: Sowing Certificate / Self-Declaration of Sown Crop
deadline_or_season: Season-specific cutoff dates notified by the Karnataka Agriculture Department for each Kharif and Rabi season.
source_authority: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka & Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
source_document_title: Karnataka Samrakshane Crop Insurance Operational Guidelines & PMFBY Guidelines
validity_notes: Karnataka implements PMFBY and Restructured Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS) natively via the state Samrakshane portal.

name_en: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) & Modified Interest Subvention Scheme (MISS)
name_kn: ಕಿಸಾನ್ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ (ಕೆಸಿಸಿ) ಮತ್ತು ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಸಹಾಯಧನ ಯೋಜನೆ
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI / Reserve Bank of India / NABARD
description: Institutional short-term crop credit facility providing subsidized working capital to farmers for crop cultivation, seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and post-harvest maintenance expenses.
purpose: To ensure timely and affordable institutional credit availability to farmers, protecting them from informal high-interest debt.
eligible_farmer_types: Self Help Groups (SHGs) / Joint Liability Groups (JLGs)
location_scope: All India (including all 31 districts of Karnataka)
benefit_summary: Short-term crop loan up to ₹3,00,000 at a subsidized benchmark interest rate of 7.0% p.a., with an additional 3.0% Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI), effectively reducing interest to 4.0% p.a. for farmers who repay promptly within the due date.
eligibility_summary: All individual or joint landholding farmers, tenant cultivators, and sharecroppers with valid land records or proof of agricultural cultivation.
application_method: Apply at any Commercial Bank branch, Regional Rural Bank (Karnataka Gramin Bank / Karnataka Vikas Grameena Bank), District Central Cooperative Bank (DCCB), Primary Agricultural Credit Society (PACS), or online via the Jan Samarth portal.
official_contact: Local Lead District Bank / Branch Agricultural Field Officer
deadline_or_season: Continuous year-round availability through banking channels.
source_authority: Reserve Bank of India & Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
source_document_title: RBI Master Circular on Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme & MISS Guidelines
validity_notes: Verified active nationwide; also extended to dairy, animal husbandry, and fisheries working capital requirements.

government_level: Central with Karnataka Agriculture Department Implementation
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka & Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
description: Comprehensive soil sampling and diagnostic service providing farmers with customized soil test reports and crop-wise scientific fertilizer recommendations.
purpose: To evaluate soil nutrient deficiencies, eliminate wasteful over-fertilization, and promote balanced application of primary, secondary, and micronutrients.
benefit_summary: Free soil testing analyzing 12 chemical and physical parameters (Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, Sulphur, Zinc, Iron, Copper, Manganese, Boron, pH, Electrical Conductivity, and Organic Carbon) along with tailored fertilizer and soil amendment advice.
eligibility_summary: Open to all agricultural landholders across all agro-climatic zones of Karnataka.
application_method: Submit soil samples through the local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK), Taluk Agricultural Officer, or District Soil Testing Laboratory.
official_contact: Local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) Agricultural Officer
documents_required: Farmer contact details and field survey number
deadline_or_season: Continuous cyclic soil sample collection (ideally pre-sowing or post-harvest).
source_authority: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India & Karnataka Agriculture Department
validity_notes: Active in Karnataka; integrated with Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY) soil health initiatives.

department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
description: Flagship Karnataka rainwater harvesting and dryland farming initiative providing subsidized farm ponds, polythene lining, pump sets, and micro-irrigation systems in drought-prone areas.
purpose: To harvest in-situ rainwater for critical life-saving protective irrigation during prolonged dry spells in rainfed agro-climatic zones.
location_scope: Notified rainfed and drought-prone taluks across Karnataka
benefit_summary: Financial subsidy for farm pond (Krishi Honda) excavation, 500-micron polythene lining to eliminate seepage, diesel/solar lift pumps, micro-irrigation (drip/sprinkler), and shade nets. Subsidies typically range from 80% to 90% for SC/ST farmers and 50% to 80% for general farmers depending on the component.
eligibility_summary: Dryland/rainfed agricultural landholders in officially notified rainfed taluks of Karnataka registered with valid FRUITS ID and RTC.
application_method: Apply online through the Karnataka Raita Mitra portal (raitamitra.karnataka.gov.in) or at the local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) / Taluk Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) office.
official_contact: Taluk Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) / Raitha Samparka Kendra
deadline_or_season: Annual action plan sanction batches announced by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka.
source_authority: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
source_document_title: Krishi Bhagya Scheme Operational Guidelines & Government Orders, GoK
validity_notes: Active flagship Karnataka state program focused on rainfed and drought-prone agricultural zones.

department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
description: State agricultural initiative promoting climate-resilient minor millet cultivation and providing direct cash incentives to registered Karnataka farmers via DBT.
purpose: To encourage cultivation of nutrient-rich, climate-resilient minor millets (Ragi, Foxtail millet/Navane, Little millet/Same, Kodo millet/Haraka, Proso millet/Baragu, Barnyard millet/Oodalu) and supplement dryland farm incomes.
location_scope: All Karnataka districts cultivating notified millets
benefit_summary: Direct financial assistance of ₹10,000 per hectare (up to a maximum ceiling of 2 hectares per farmer) directly transferred to Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts via DBT through the FRUITS database upon crop verification.
eligibility_summary: Karnataka farmers growing notified minor millets on their land, verified through digital crop survey and registered on the FRUITS portal.
application_method: Registration on the FRUITS portal (fruits.karnataka.gov.in) and crop declaration through the Karnataka Crop Survey mobile application / Raitha Samparka Kendra.
official_contact: Local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) / Agricultural Officer
deadline_or_season: Season-specific registration during Kharif and Rabi sowing and digital crop survey windows.
source_authority: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
source_document_title: Raita Siri Scheme Notification & FRUITS Portal Guidelines
validity_notes: Active in Karnataka. Direct Benefit Transfer is executed through the FRUITS portal after cross-verification with digital crop survey data.

name_en: PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop (Micro Irrigation Scheme)
name_kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಕೃಷಿ ಸಿಂಚಾಯಿ ಯೋಜನೆ - ಹನಿ ಮತ್ತು ತುಂತುರು ನೀರಾವರಿ
department: Department of Agriculture & Department of Horticulture, Government of Karnataka
description: Centrally sponsored scheme with Karnataka state top-up subsidy for installing drip and sprinkler micro-irrigation systems to maximize water use efficiency and crop yield.
purpose: To promote precision irrigation, conserve groundwater resources, and improve crop productivity per unit of water.
benefit_summary: Subsidized installation of drip and sprinkler irrigation systems. In Karnataka, combined Central and State subsidies reach up to 90% for SC/ST small/marginal farmers and up to 75% for general category farmers (up to a 5-acre / 2-hectare ceiling).
eligibility_summary: Farmers having cultivable land with an assured water source (borewell, open well, canal, or farm pond) registered in FRUITS.
application_method: Apply online through the Karnataka Agriculture/Horticulture department portal or at the nearest Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) / Senior Assistant Director of Horticulture (SADH) office.
official_contact: Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) / Taluk Horticulture Office
source_authority: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI & Dept of Agriculture/Horticulture, GoK
source_document_title: PMKSY Per Drop More Crop Revised Operational Guidelines
validity_notes: Active in Karnataka across both Agriculture (field crops) and Horticulture (vegetables/fruits) departments.

name_en: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) / Farm Mechanization
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
description: Financial subsidy scheme for purchasing farm implements, power tillers, transplanters, weeders, harvesters, and establishing Custom Hiring Centres (CHC).
purpose: To reduce cultivation costs, overcome farm labor scarcity, and increase timeliness of field operations through mechanized equipment.
eligible_farmer_types: FPOs / SHGs / Custom Hiring Centre operators
benefit_summary: Financial subsidy ranging from 40% to 50% for general category farmers and 50% to 90% for SC/ST small/marginal farmers on approved agricultural machinery/equipment from empanelled manufacturers.
eligibility_summary: Landholding farmers registered in FRUITS with valid RTC. Priority given to small, marginal, SC/ST, and women farmers.
application_method: Apply online through the Karnataka Raita Mitra portal (raitamitra.karnataka.gov.in) or submit application at the local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK).
official_contact: Raitha Samparka Kendra / Assistant Director of Agriculture
deadline_or_season: Periodic priority-based allotment batches announced by the Karnataka Agriculture Department.
source_authority: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka & Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
source_document_title: SMAM Operational Guidelines & Karnataka Mechanization Circulars
validity_notes: Active across all Karnataka districts via Raitha Samparka Kendras with DBT transfer.

name_en: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH) - Karnataka
name_kn: ಸಮಗ್ರ ತೋಟಗಾರಿಕೆ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಮಿಷನ್ (ತೋಟಗಾರಿಕಾ ಬೆಳೆಗಳ ಯೋಜನೆ)
department: Department of Horticulture, Government of Karnataka
description: Holistic support scheme for horticulture crop growers covering quality planting material, orchard establishment, protected polyhouses, shade nets, and post-harvest infrastructure.
purpose: To expand acreage and production of high-value horticultural crops (banana, mango, tomato, chilli, onion, spices) and enhance post-harvest returns.
location_scope: All Karnataka districts with horticultural cultivation
benefit_summary: Subsidies of 40% to 50% for establishment of new perennial/non-perennial orchards, 50% for polyhouse/shade net protected cultivation, and financial assistance for pack houses, cold storage, and drip fertigation.
eligibility_summary: Farmers possessing cultivable land suitable for horticultural crops with assured irrigation and valid FRUITS ID.
application_method: Apply through the Senior Assistant Director of Horticulture (SADH) at taluk level or via the Karnataka Horticulture department portal.
official_contact: Taluk Senior Assistant Director of Horticulture (SADH) / RSK
documents_required: Soil and Water Testing Report (for protected cultivation)
deadline_or_season: Annual action plan sanction cycle by the Department of Horticulture.
source_authority: Department of Horticulture, Government of Karnataka & Ministry of Agriculture, GoI
source_document_title: MIDH Operational Guidelines & Karnataka Horticulture Schemes Portal
validity_notes: Active in Karnataka; administered by District Horticulture Officers.

name_en: FRUITS Portal (Farmer Registration & Unified Beneficiary Information System)
name_kn: ಫ್ರೂಟ್ಸ್ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್ (ರೈತರ ನೋಂದಣಿ ಮತ್ತು ಏಕೀಕೃತ ಫಲಾನುಭವಿ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ)
department: e-Governance Department & Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
description: Unified digital platform generating a unique Farmer ID (FID) linking farmer identity, Aadhaar, bank accounts, and land parcel (RTC/Bhoomi) records for all Karnataka agricultural schemes.
purpose: To eliminate duplicate document submissions and enable seamless, transparent Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) across all state agricultural, horticultural, sericultural, and animal husbandry schemes.
eligible_farmer_types: All landholding and tenant farmers in Karnataka
benefit_summary: One-time registration generates a 12-digit FID that automatically qualifies verified farmers for DBT subsidies, MSP procurement, crop insurance claims, and input incentives across all departments without repeated physical documentation.
eligibility_summary: Any farmer owning or cultivating agricultural land in Karnataka.
application_method: Self-registration at fruits.karnataka.gov.in or through Grama One, Karnataka One, Village Accountants, or Raitha Samparka Kendras (RSK).
source_authority: Centre for e-Governance, Government of Karnataka
source_document_title: Karnataka FRUITS Portal Guidelines & e-Governance Orders
validity_notes: Mandatory foundational prerequisite for all Karnataka government agricultural subsidies and PM-KISAN state verification.

name_en: Unverified Experimental Solar Drone Pilot Scheme
description: Unverified experimental scheme record included strictly to test safety mechanisms and ensure unverified programs are never recommended to farmers.
purpose: Testing safety isolation against unverified records.
validity_notes: Test record with STATUS_UNCERTAIN status; must be excluded from farmer recommendations.
